question: Rishi travels 198 km at 66 km/hr, the next 584 km at 73 km/hr and the next 656 km at 82 km/hr. What is his average speed (in km/hr) for the whole journey? (Round off your answer to two decimal places)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly calculate the time taken for each segment of the journey using Time = Distance ÷ Speed.

Total Time = 198÷66 + 584÷73 + 656÷82 = 3 + 8 + 8 = 19 hours.

Total Distance = 198 + 584 + 656 = 1438 km.

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time = 1438 ÷ 19 = 75.684... km/hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 75.68 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
 
 19
